newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sales light $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sales light $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 300 slaughter steers and 900 heifers; 92,200 head confirmed for the week to date including 20,400 formulated cattle and 400 contract cattle to be shipped this week. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00.
Wk to date - 92,200 Week Ago - 131,100 Year Ago - 75,000
